----Respondents Connected With S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 717/2024 Mohendar Jeet Chaddha S/o Shri Ravel Singh, aged about 72 years, R/o 42, Gol Market, New Delhi.
-----Petitioner Versus 1. State of Rajasthan, through PP 2.
Dr. Preeti Soni W/o Shri Neeraj Dangi, R/o Flat No. 263, Priyadarshini Marg, Shyam Nagar Extension, Jaipur.
-----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Swadeep Singh Hora assisted by  Mr. Sandeep Bansiwal  Mr. Amit Kaviya
For Respondent(s) : Mr. M.K. Sheoran, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR UPMAN  Order 17/01/2024 1.

The instant pre-arrest bail applications have been filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C. on behalf of the petitioners, who are having apprehension of their arrest in connection with FIR No.109/2021 Purushottam Lal Soni S/O Shri Guljari ... vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jp:2777) on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163103695/
1 registered at Police Station Shyam Nagar, District Jaipur City (South) for the offences under Sections 406, 420 & 120-B of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Shyam Nagar, District Jaipur City
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that accused- petitioners have falsely been implicated in this case.
Learned counsel submits that petitioners are land owners and they have entered into an agreement with the developer.

Subsequently, the [2024:RJ-JP:2777] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-14720/2023]
developer entered into an agreement with the complainant in which petitioners are not party.
Thereafter, a dispute arose between the developer and complainant which is purely of civil nature wherein, the victim is claiming refund of advance amount paid by her in allotment of other flats.

It is further submitted that the developer approached this Court to quash the FIR by way of S.B.
Criminal Misc. Petition No.3435/2021 wherein Co-ordinate Bench of this Court has granted interim protection to the developer considering the nature of allegation made in the FIR.

It is further contended that after thorough investigation, negative final report was submitted by the agency but without any cogent reasons, further investigation is being conducted by the investigation agency.
No custodial interrogation is required from the petitioners as there is no specific allegation against the petitioners in the FIR.
3. Learned Public Prosecutor vehemently opposes these bail applications and submits that complainant has duly been informed about hearing of these bail applications.
However, despite information, none has put in appearance on behalf of the complainant.

4. Considering the contentions put-forth by the counsel for the petitioners and taking into account the totality of facts and circumstances of the case, especially the facts that there is no specific allegations against the petitioners, complainant has entered into agreement with the developer wherein petitioners are not party as also the fact that an interim order is already operating in favour of the developer in CRLMP No.3435/2021, but [2024:RJ-JP:2777] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-14720/2023]
without expressing any opinion on the merits/demerits of the case, this court deems it just and proper to allow these anticipatory bail applications.
5. Accordingly, these anticipatory bail applications are allowed.

The S.H.O/I.O/Arresting Officer,
Police Station Shyam Nagar, District Jaipur City (South) in FIR No.109/2021 is directed that in the event of arrest of the petitioners - (1) Purushottam Lal Soni S/o Shri Guljari Lal Soni, (2) Mohendar Jeet Chaddha S/o Shri Ravel Singh, they shall be released on bail, provided each of them furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties in the sum of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the S.H.O/I.O/Arresting Officer of the concerned Police Station on the following conditions:-
(i) that the petitioners shall make themselves available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) that the petitioners shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or any police officer, and Purushottam Lal Soni S/O Shri Guljari ... vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jp:2777) on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163103695/
2 (iii) that the petitioners shall not leave India without previous permission of the court.
(ANIL KUMAR UPMAN),J CHARU SONI/164 & C-1 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
